verdict: A thin day: one concrete pipeline tool update worth noting, the rest is event listings, show promo, and academic papers outside scope.

stories.headline: Flame 2027.2 adds USD scene import and AI-generated normal maps from video
stories.body: Autodesk's Flame 2027.2 release adds the ability to import USD scenes directly into the compositor, plus a new AI model that generates normal maps from video footage. No pricing or licence changes mentioned. This is a direct pipeline feature for facilities already on Flame and moving toward USD-based workflows between DCCs.
stories.why: USD import in Flame narrows the gap between comp and a USD-centric Houdini/Karma pipeline.

stories.headline: Epic makes Megascans library free again, permanently
stories.body: Epic has restored free access to Megascans, over 23,000 scanned environment assets, buildings, plants and materials, usable in games, VFX and visualization. The library had previously been pulled behind a paywall; Epic says this reversal is permanent. No licence restrictions on commercial VFX use are mentioned beyond the standard terms.
stories.why: Free high-quality scan assets cut sourcing time for environment and set-dressing work.
